papers.title: What Makes Good Agentic Data? An ACE Lens on Data Generation for LLM Agents
papers.brief: 本文提出一个面向LLM智能体数据生成的两层框架：先将智能体数据统一表示为环境、任务、交互轨迹与验证器组成的因子化对象，再用Accuracy-Complexity-divErsity（ACE）视角分析数据分布设计。
papers.tldr: 用ACE框架重新定义智能体数据生成
papers.what_it_is: 本文提出一个面向LLM智能体数据生成的两层框架：先将智能体数据统一表示为环境、任务、交互轨迹与验证器组成的因子化对象，再用Accuracy-Complexity-divErsity（ACE）视角分析数据分布设计。
key_points: 将agentic data抽象为$(E,q,τ,v)$，统一描述环境规范、任务信号、交互过程和可选验证器
提出ACE约束分布设计框架：准确性保证数据 grounded 且一致，复杂度匹配学习者能力，多样性控制覆盖与冗余
总结领域趋势：从单纯扩大数据量转向执行验证、学习者相对难度校准和更深层行为覆盖
papers.why_notable: 该工作为LLM智能体训练数据的生成、筛选和评估提供了统一语言，有助于避免“数据越多越好”的粗放范式，推动更有效、可验证、可自适应的智能体数据构建。
papers.abstract: LLM agents increasingly rely on generated interaction data to learn how to interact with external environments. Agentic data generation must maintain consistency among environments, tasks, interactions, and success signals while producing experience that is useful rather than merely abundant. Existing work spans many agent domains, but domain-centered organization and heterogeneous evaluation often obscure common generation mechanisms and conflate candidate construction with verification and selection. This work develops a two-level framework for the field. First, we represent agentic data as a common factorized object $(E,q,τ,v)$, comprising an environment specification, task signal, interaction realization, and optional verifier. We organize generation paradigms by their primary anchor and dependency structure. Second, we formulate generation as constrained distribution design through the Accuracy-Complexity-divErsity (ACE) lens. Accuracy establishes the feasible support of grounded and internally consistent data. Within this support, Complexity places learning mass relative to the capability of a declared learner and execution configuration, while divErsity controls coverage and redundancy of data. Using this framework, we explore how prior work verifies generated experience, constructs and calibrates difficulty, and expands behavioral coverage. The literature reveals a shift toward execution-grounded accuracy, learner-relative complexity, and diversity beyond surface variation or dataset size. We further discuss broader directions and emerging trends in agentic data generation through the ACE lens, including their implications for scaling, data sources, training regimes and adaptive learning. Overall, the central challenge is not simply to generate more data, but to continually allocate valid, informative, and non-redundant experience as agents and environments evolve.

papers.title: UrbanGround: From Local Perception to Spatial Agency in a Real-Scale City
papers.brief: 论文提出 UrbanGround，一个基于香港全域3D地理空间数据构建的真实尺度城市沙盒，用于测试MLLM智能体从街景局部感知到闭环导航行动的能力。它支持第一人称探索、交互式地图导航，并评估空间问答、远距离导航、路线变化与行人动态下的鲁棒性。
papers.tldr: UrbanGround评测MLLM真实城市空间行动
papers.what_it_is: 论文提出 UrbanGround，一个基于香港全域3D地理空间数据构建的真实尺度城市沙盒，用于测试MLLM智能体从街景局部感知到闭环导航行动的能力。它支持第一人称探索、交互式地图导航，并评估空间问答、远距离导航、路线变化与行人动态下的鲁棒性。
key_points: 构建物理约束的香港3D城市复刻环境，支持智能体第一人称闭环交互与地图辅助导航。
系统评估MLLM智能体的局部场景理解、短程空间推理、远距离目标导航和行人感知移动能力。
发现当前模型具备一定原子视觉与短程推理能力，但长程探索中难以将局部能力组合成稳定的目标导向行为，错误会持续累积。
papers.why_notable: 该工作把MLLM智能体评测从静态街景理解推进到真实尺度城市中的空间行动，为研究开放城市环境下的具身导航、空间推理和鲁棒智能体提供了重要基准。
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can interpret a street view, but urban agency depends on whether such local evidence remains useful after the agent starts to move. In this paper, we investigate how far current MLLM agents can turn local urban perception into reliable action in a complicated real-scale city. We propose UrbanGround, the first sandbox to make this question testable in a physically constrained replica of Hong Kong built from territory-wide 3D geospatial data. UrbanGround supports closed-loop interaction from a first-person view and provides an interactive map for navigation. Agents can directly enter the 3D city and explore from a first-person view. Our analysis follows the growth of the spatial problem through three research questions. We first test whether an agent can ground a local scene well enough to answer spatial questions after active observation. Then we ask whether that grounding supports navigation as destinations become farther away and less explicit. Finally, we examine whether the resulting behavior survives changes in route availability and pedestrian motion. Contemporary MLLM agents usually show useful atomic abilities in visual recognition and short-range spatial reasoning, while orientation and pedestrian-aware movement remain unreliable. Their central failure emerges over extended exploration, where local abilities do not compose into sustained goal-directed behavior and errors accumulate without effective correction. We hope UrbanGround will support broader study of how far current MLLM agents can explore reliably in complex, open-ended urban environments.

papers.title: WikiSkill: Compiling Agent Experience into Persistent Knowledge for Skill Evolution
papers.brief: WikiSkill提出一种将智能体原始执行经验、持久知识库和可执行技能分离并协同进化的框架。它持续把交互经验整理进wiki，再用这些累积知识指导后续技能更新。
papers.tldr: 用持久Wiki积累经验，促进智能体技能进化
papers.what_it_is: WikiSkill提出一种将智能体原始执行经验、持久知识库和可执行技能分离并协同进化的框架。它持续把交互经验整理进wiki，再用这些累积知识指导后续技能更新。
key_points: 将零散优化历史沉淀为可复用的持久知识库，避免每轮技能进化从分散经验中重新归纳
在多种基准和模型上优于现有技能进化方法，并在多数设置下超过无技能基线
发现技能可跨模型、跨模型家族迁移，且他模型进化出的技能有时优于自进化技能
papers.why_notable: 该工作强调长期经验记忆对智能体能力增长的重要性，为构建可复用、可迁移的Agent技能库提供了系统框架，并显示技能进化可与模型规模扩展互补。
papers.abstract: Agent skills package specialized knowledge and workflows into reusable resources that extend AI agent capabilities. Recent work automatically discovers such skills from agent experience, which enables agents to progressively adapt through interaction. However, the insights that guide skill development typically remain scattered across optimization histories, limiting their systematic reuse across iterations. We introduce WikiSkill, a framework that co-evolves agent skills with a persistent knowledge base (wiki). At a high level, WikiSkill separates raw execution experience, accumulated knowledge, and executable skills, while continuously consolidating experience into the wiki, which subsequent skill updates can build on. Across diverse benchmarks and models, WikiSkill consistently outperforms state-of-the-art skill-evolution methods and improves over no-skill baselines in most model-benchmark settings. We find that skill evolution complements model scaling: larger models generally benefit more from evolved skills, while smaller models with skills can outperform substantially larger models without them. We also find that evolved skills transfer effectively across models and model families, and skills evolved by other models can outperform self-evolved skills. Finally, our ablation studies confirm that persistent knowledge accumulation in the wiki is critical for effective skill evolution. These results demonstrate the benefits of systematically accumulating and refining agent experience for developing reusable and transferable skills.

papers.title: INTENT-AS-A-TOOL Makes it Easy to Track Agentic Misalignment
papers.brief: 本文提出 INTENT-AS-A-TOOL，为模型加入面向特定意图的工具调用通道，用工具调用概率来刻画其执行某类目标行为的倾向。该方法用于监测 LLM 智能体在目标冲突和压力下产生的有害行动意图。
papers.tldr: 用意图工具细粒度追踪智能体失配
papers.what_it_is: 本文提出 INTENT-AS-A-TOOL，为模型加入面向特定意图的工具调用通道，用工具调用概率来刻画其执行某类目标行为的倾向。该方法用于监测 LLM 智能体在目标冲突和压力下产生的有害行动意图。
key_points: 发现有害执行前常在 CoT 推理中出现可观测的意图信号
将粗粒度的事后 CoT 标签扩展为生成过程中的密集意图轨迹
无需额外裁判模型，通过意图工具调用概率定位可在线干预的关键步骤
papers.why_notable: 该工作为智能体安全监控提供了更细粒度、可在线使用的意图追踪机制，有助于在有害行动发生前识别并干预 agentic misalignment。
papers.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) are deployed as autonomous agents, safety failures increasingly involve consequential actions. We study agentic misalignment, where agents take harmful actions under goal conflicts and pressures. Using chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring, we find that harmful execution is often preceded by intent signals in reasoning. However, post-hoc CoT labels are too coarse to show how intent changes during generation. We introduce INTENT-AS-A-TOOL, an approach that adds intent-targeted tools to give the model a dedicated channel for expressing commitment to a target behavior. The probability of calling an intent tool provides a judge-free, fine-grained signal of the model's tendency to pursue that behavior. Our results show that INTENT-AS-A-TOOL complements CoT monitoring, expands post-hoc CoT labels into dense trajectories, and identifies critical steps for online intervention. These findings suggest that action preferences are useful for tracking agentic misalignment during reasoning. Our code and data are accessible: https://github.com/RebeccaZhang22/intent-as-a-tool.

papers.title: Naive Prompt Optimization: Rethinking the Need for Complex Prompt Search
papers.brief: 论文提出 Naive Prompt Optimization（NPO），一种轻量级单谱系提示优化方法：用教师模型结合 rollout 反馈迭代改写提示词。实验显示，它在多类任务和交互式游戏中可达到或超过复杂提示搜索方法 GEPA 的效果，并减少 rollout 开销。
papers.tldr: 简单线性提示优化可媲美复杂搜索
papers.what_it_is: 论文提出 Naive Prompt Optimization（NPO），一种轻量级单谱系提示优化方法：用教师模型结合 rollout 反馈迭代改写提示词。实验显示，它在多类任务和交互式游戏中可达到或超过复杂提示搜索方法 GEPA 的效果，并减少 rollout 开销。
key_points: NPO 不进行复杂搜索，只沿单一路径反复修订提示词，依赖教师模型推理与反馈改进。
在多项任务上以更少 rollout 达到与 GEPA 相当或更好的性能，且教师模型越强优势越明显。
NPO 优化出的提示可直接迁移到其他学生模型，尤其在同一模型家族内效果更稳定。
papers.why_notable: 该工作挑战了提示优化必须依赖复杂搜索器的趋势，表明强教师模型的推理能力可部分替代优化器侧复杂度，有助于以更低成本提升智能体表现。
papers.abstract: Efficiently improving autonomous agents across diverse tasks is central to accelerating recursive self-improvement (RSI) in agentic AI, with prompt optimization emerging as a promising approach capable of delivering performance gains comparable to those achieved by fine-tuning model weights, while reducing computational costs in both optimization and serving. However, recent developments increasingly favor unnecessarily complex prompt optimizers. We introduce Naive Prompt Optimization (NPO), a lightweight single-lineage method that iteratively revises prompts using a teacher model with rollout feedback. NPO achieves comparable or better performance than GEPA with fewer rollouts, and its advantage increases with stronger teacher models, suggesting that stronger teacher reasoning can partially substitute for optimizer-side search complexity. In interactive games, NPO remains broadly competitive with GEPA, while GRPO performs better on some tasks less amenable to prompt optimization. We also show that NPO-optimized prompts elicit similar performance improvements when applied verbatim to other student models, especially across models within the same family. Overall, our preliminary results show that simple, linear prompt optimization can rival substantially more sophisticated and complex search procedures.

papers.title: BALMS: Benchmarking Agentic LLMs for Longitudinal Mental Health Sensing
papers.brief: 论文提出 BALMS，用于系统评测 LLM 智能体能否基于长期可穿戴设备行为与生理信号预测心理健康量表分数，并生成有证据支撑的解释。基准覆盖3个真实纵向数据集、2类任务、3种智能体范式和5种开闭源LLM骨干。
papers.tldr: 首个纵向心理健康感知LLM智能体基准
papers.what_it_is: 论文提出 BALMS，用于系统评测 LLM 智能体能否基于长期可穿戴设备行为与生理信号预测心理健康量表分数，并生成有证据支撑的解释。基准覆盖3个真实纵向数据集、2类任务、3种智能体范式和5种开闭源LLM骨干。
key_points: 任务包括封闭式幸福感/心理状态分数预测，以及由 LLM-as-Judge 自动评分的理由生成
实验发现零样本智能体通常难以超过简单均值基线，除非使用更强模型或紧凑且语义明确的特征
Chain-of-thought 可提升部分推理型模型，但不能保证时间证据扎实或数值预测准确
papers.why_notable: 该工作把LLM个人健康智能体从短期检索查询推进到长期心理健康推理评测，揭示了当前智能体在时间 grounding、历史选择性检索和可解释行为特征推理上的关键短板。
papers.abstract: Mental health assessment relies on episodic self-report scales, which convert subjective states such as stress into numerical scores but provide only sparse snapshots of wellbeing. Wearable devices offer longitudinal behavioral and physiological signals for continuous, low-burden monitoring. Recent LLM-driven personal-health agents enable natural language queries over wearable signals, but mainly handle short-term, retrieval-based lookups (e.g., highest step count over a week). They do not evaluate whether agents can reason over long-term signals to predict wellbeing scores paired with evidence-grounded rationales. To address this gap, we introduce BALMS, the first systematic benchmark of LLM-based agentic systems for longitudinal mental health sensing. BALMS spans 3 real-world longitudinal datasets, 2 task families (closed-form wellbeing-score prediction and rationale generation auto-graded by an LLM-as-Judge), 3 agentic paradigms evaluated across 5 open- and closed-source LLM backbones. We find that zero-shot agents rarely outperform a simple mean baseline, except with stronger backbones or compact, semantically meaningful features. Chain-of-thought prompting improves reasoning-oriented backbones, but does not guarantee temporal grounding or numerical correctness. Together with more analysis on efficiency and temporal scaling, BALMS highlights the need for longitudinal mental health agents that selectively retrieve history, ground temporal evidence, and reason over interpretable behavioral features.

papers.title: Calibrated Enough to Know, Not Calibrated to Act: Fabricated Evidence Makes LLM Agents Commit to the Unknowable
papers.brief: 本文系统评估12个前沿LLM在“不可预测问题”上的行动决策，发现专业化证据面板会显著提高模型做出方向性判断的概率，即使面板数据完全伪造也同样有效。研究进一步表明，问题不在知识能力或概率校准，而在“是否行动”的门控机制失效。
papers.tldr: 伪造权威证据会诱导LLM智能体盲目行动
papers.what_it_is: 本文系统评估12个前沿LLM在“不可预测问题”上的行动决策，发现专业化证据面板会显著提高模型做出方向性判断的概率，即使面板数据完全伪造也同样有效。研究进一步表明，问题不在知识能力或概率校准，而在“是否行动”的门控机制失效。
key_points: 在证据逐步增强时，模型对不可知问题的承诺率从6.5%升至54.0%；完全伪造的数据面板也能将承诺率从24.5%升至36.8%，接近真实数据的37.6%。
模型在可回答问题上几乎总能正确作答，也能在行动前识别90%的问题为不可知，说明失败集中在act/don't-act决策门控。
用540个合成案例监督微调3B模型，可将原始案例承诺率降至0.0%并迁移到三个未见领域，但在刚性输出格式下鲁棒性下降。
papers.why_notable: 该研究揭示了LLM智能体部署中的关键风险：模型可能被权威外观而非真实信息驱动去采取行动。它将失败机制定位到可训练但脆弱的行动门控，为提升智能体安全性、拒答能力和决策可靠性提供了明确方向。
papers.abstract: An LLM agent shown a professional-looking market panel commits to a directional call on a provably unpredictable question far more often than one asked the bare question: across 12 frontier models, commitment rises from 6.5% to 54.0% as evidence is escalated. It commits just as readily when every number on the panel is invented: fabricating the entire display, so nothing the model can see is true except the question itself, still lifts commitment from 24.5% to 36.8%, statistically indistinguishable from the 37.6% produced by genuine market data. What unlocks confident action is not information but the authority of its packaging. The failure is narrow and locatable. Incapacity is not the answer: on matched answerable questions attached to the same panels, the same models answer essentially always, at near-perfect accuracy. Nor is it belief - stated probabilities barely move across the gradient that swings action by 48 points, and score worse than a climatological baseline. Missing judgment isn't it either: asked to classify a question's knowability before acting, models call it irreducible 90% of the time and then commit on just 0.4% of those. The act/don't-act gate is what fails, and the effect is concentrated in a few models rather than universal. Because the gate is separable, it can be trained. Supervised fine-tuning of a 3B model on 540 synthetic cases, predominantly dice, coins, jars and timers, drives commitment to 0.0% on the original cases and transfers to three unseen domains. It does not survive everything: the gate holds exactly when the response format leaves room to reason, and rigid formats that remove that room leave the model confident and wrong on questions it otherwise answers correctly. The gate is trainable and context-fragile, and deployment needs both halves of that sentence.

papers.title: Thinking on Shots: Consistent Multi-Shot Video Editing with Agentic Reasoning
papers.brief: 论文提出多指令多镜头长视频编辑（MMLVE）任务，关注跨镜头一致性、多指令解耦和时空结构无损。作者构建结合 LLM 与 VLM 的 MMLVE-Agent，在镜头级分解视频并精确解析编辑指令，同时发布 MMLVE-Bench 与配套评测指标。
papers.tldr: 用智能体实现一致的多镜头长视频编辑
papers.what_it_is: 论文提出多指令多镜头长视频编辑（MMLVE）任务，关注跨镜头一致性、多指令解耦和时空结构无损。作者构建结合 LLM 与 VLM 的 MMLVE-Agent，在镜头级分解视频并精确解析编辑指令，同时发布 MMLVE-Bench 与配套评测指标。
key_points: 定义三大目标：跨镜头编辑一致性（CSEC）、多指令解耦（MID）、时空结构零破坏（ZDSS）
利用 LLM/VLM 协同进行镜头级视频解耦、实体追踪与复杂指令解析，减少长视频分块带来的幻觉和不连续
构建 MMLVE-Bench，覆盖复杂真实时空动态、高密度异构指令和稀疏随机实体分布
papers.why_notable: 将视频编辑从短片段推进到复杂多镜头长视频场景，并用智能体推理显著提升一致性和可控性；实验显示优于 Seedance 2.0 等闭源 SOTA，对长视频生成与后期编辑应用有实用价值。
papers.abstract: While generative AI has significantly advanced video editing, existing methods primarily focus on single-shot or short video clips. Editing long videos with multiple instructions remains a formidable challenge. Naive chunking strategies, e.g., fixed-duration segmentation, often lead to entity fragmentation, severe editing hallucinations, and disrupted temporal continuity. To bridge this gap, we introduce the Multi-Instruction Multi-Shot Long-Video Editing (MMLVE) task, which is structured around three core objectives: Cross-Shot Editing Consistency (CSEC), Multi-Instruction Decoupling (MID), and Zero-Destruction on Spatiotemporal Structure (ZDSS). To tackle these three unique challenges, we introduce an agentic editing framework that leverages the synergy of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to achieve shot-level video decoupling and precise instruction parsing. Furthermore, to comprehensively evaluate this task, we construct MMLVE-Bench, which is an MMLVE-focused dataset characterized by complex real-world spatiotemporal dynamics, high-density heterogeneous instructions, and sparse, random entity distributions. Three MMLVE-focused evaluation metrics are further exploited to assess the quality of the editing results. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our MMLVE-Agent outperforms existing closed-source SOTA approaches (e.g., Seedance 2.0), successfully eliminating editing hallucinations, preserving cross-shot editing consistency, and attaining seamless spatiotemporal transitions.

papers.title: TraceBench: Controlled Evaluation of LLM Agents for Time-Series Root-Cause Attribution
papers.brief: 论文提出 TraceBench，一个基于物理动力系统仿真的可控基准，用于评估 LLM 智能体在时序异常与根因归因任务中的表现。每个任务要求智能体判断系统参数是否被改变，并识别具体根因参数。
papers.tldr: 可控评测LLM智能体时序根因归因能力
papers.what_it_is: 论文提出 TraceBench，一个基于物理动力系统仿真的可控基准，用于评估 LLM 智能体在时序异常与根因归因任务中的表现。每个任务要求智能体判断系统参数是否被改变，并识别具体根因参数。
key_points: 基于三个可解释机械系统生成时序观测与根因归因任务，便于控制实验条件
系统评估四种 LLM 智能体，并公开数据集、智能体轨迹、实验结果和排行榜
发现领域上下文显著提升表现，智能体更依赖数值控制台输出而非可视化分析
papers.why_notable: 该工作填补了 LLM 智能体在时序根因分析中缺乏可控系统评测的空白，为真实系统运维、异常诊断和智能体数据分析能力研究提供了可复现基准。
papers.abstract: LLM agents are increasingly applied to anomaly detection and root-cause analysis in time-series observations collected from real-world systems; however, their performance on these tasks has not been systematically evaluated under controlled conditions. We introduce TraceBench, a simulation-based framework for generating controlled root-cause attribution tasks. In each generated task, an agent receives time-series observations produced by simulating a physical dynamical system and must determine whether a system parameter was altered during the simulation and, if so, which one. Using TraceBench, we generate tasks from three interpretable mechanical systems and systematically evaluate four LLM agents across controlled experimental conditions, yielding new insights into how these agents analyze time-series observations from dynamical systems. Our results show that agents benefit substantially from domain context and explore data primarily through numerical console output rather than visualizations. We also find that agents generally perform worse when required to produce a Python script that maps each time-series sample to a predicted root-cause label than when they submit predictions directly. We release our datasets, agent trajectories, experimental results, and a leaderboard on our website, tracebench.github.io.

papers.title: When Text Misleads: Inconsistent-Aware Reasoning for Audio-Grounded Dialogue
papers.brief: 论文提出跨模态不一致视角，构建 ContraTalk 基准，用于评估模型是否真正依据语音中的韵律、情绪和说话方式进行对话理解。作者还提出 Audio Twin，将局部声学线索转成可读文本证据，辅助推理模型进行语音扎根判断。
papers.tldr: 揭示口语理解中的文本捷径陷阱
papers.what_it_is: 论文提出跨模态不一致视角，构建 ContraTalk 基准，用于评估模型是否真正依据语音中的韵律、情绪和说话方式进行对话理解。作者还提出 Audio Twin，将局部声学线索转成可读文本证据，辅助推理模型进行语音扎根判断。
key_points: ContraTalk 包含501个问答样本，覆盖互动行为、情绪状态、对话行为、社会立场和会话意图五类话语维度
强文本 LLM 在文本与语音一致样本上超过90%准确率，但在冲突样本中降至33%-48%，暴露明显文本偏置
直接 AudioLLM 仍会在约30%-40%冲突样本中选择文本诱导陷阱；Audio Twin 可提升冲突准确率并减少陷阱选择
papers.why_notable: 该研究系统定义并量化了口语对话理解中的“转写文本捷径”问题，提供了可控评测集和显式声学证据接口，对改进多模态语音理解与诊断模型是否真正利用音频信号具有实用价值。
papers.abstract: Understanding spoken dialogue requires joint reasoning over lexical content and paralinguistic acoustic signals such as emotion and conversational intent. However, existing evaluations often allow shortcuts based on transcripts or single-modality solutions, obscuring whether models genuinely ground predictions in speech. We formalize this failure mode as cross-modal disagreement, where transcripts suggest plausible but incorrect surface interpretations while acoustic cues such as prosody or speaking style support different answers. We develop a scalable framework that identifies text-biased surface interpretations and converts disagreement regions into conflict QA examples. We also include consistent cases where transcript-based and speech-grounded interpretations agree, enabling evaluation beyond adversarial audio dependence. This results in ContraTalk, a controlled benchmark containing 501 questions across five discourse dimensions: interaction behavior, emotion state, dialogue act, social stance, and conversational intent. We further develop an agentic-style reasoning framework that converts speech into an Audio Twin, a text-readable representation of localized acoustic cues that exposes acoustic evidence to the reasoning model. Experiments show that strong text-only LLMs exceed 90% accuracy in consistent cases but drop to 33-48% in conflict cases. Direct AudioLLMs provide only partial grounding, still selecting the transcript-biased trap in roughly 30-40% of conflict cases. Our Audio Twin framework improves conflict-case accuracy while reducing trap selection, but its consistent-case behavior remains backbone-dependent. These results identify transcript-based shortcuts as an important failure mode in spoken dialogue understanding and show that explicit acoustic evidence aggregation provides a more controllable interface for diagnosing and improving speech-grounded reasoning.

papers.title: From Atomic to Agentic: Towards Interpretable Evaluation of LLMs' Agentic Mathematical Capabilities
papers.brief: 本文提出一个过程级基准，用于评估大语言模型在数学解题中的智能体化能力，而不只看最终答案。该框架将解题行为对齐到可复用的数学原子能力，并覆盖文本与多模态场景中的规划、行动和反馈任务。
papers.tldr: 面向数学智能体的过程级评测基准
papers.what_it_is: 本文提出一个过程级基准，用于评估大语言模型在数学解题中的智能体化能力，而不只看最终答案。该框架将解题行为对齐到可复用的数学原子能力，并覆盖文本与多模态场景中的规划、行动和反馈任务。
key_points: 构建了从“原子能力”到“智能体行为”的结构化分类体系，用于诊断数学推理过程中的能力差异
设计规划、行动、反馈三类任务，覆盖文本和多模态数学问题
通过自动化流水线合成高质量解题轨迹，并利用受控 LLM 改写生成细粒度标注
papers.why_notable: 现有数学基准多关注最终答案，难以解释模型为何成功或失败；该工作提供了更可解释的过程级评测方式，有助于发现同等准确率模型背后的能力差异，并指导数学智能体的发展。
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are evolving from performing end-to-end mathematical reasoning to integrating agentic intelligence. However, most existing math benchmarks evaluate only final answers. This outcome-oriented evaluation provides limited diagnostic value for identifying process-level failures or rigorous logic, failing to guide the transformation of LLMs into robust agents. To bridge this gap, we present a process-level benchmark designed to evaluate the inherent agentic mathematical reasoning abilities of LLMs. Our framework aligns problem-solving agentic behaviors with a structured taxonomy of reusable mathematical atomic capabilities. We design a comprehensive suite of planning, action, and feedback tasks across both textual and multimodal contexts, supported by an automated pipeline that synthesizes high-quality trajectories and produces fine-grained annotations via controlled LLM rewriting. Experiments reveal that models with similar end-to-end accuracy can exhibit markedly different agentic capability profiles. This demonstrates that process-level evaluation is crucial for interpreting the true potential of LLMs and guiding the development of next-generation mathematical agents.

papers.title: TTPO: Test-Time Policy Optimization
papers.brief: 论文提出 Test-Time Policy Optimization（TTPO），一种无需真实标签的测试时训练方法，用多数投票伪标签路由样本，并结合自蒸馏与分组强化学习更新模型。它针对伪标签可能错误的问题，采用非对称目标：强化同意伪标签的轨迹，惩罚不同意伪标签且置信错误的轨迹。
papers.tldr: 无标签测试时优化显著提升数学推理
papers.what_it_is: 论文提出 Test-Time Policy Optimization（TTPO），一种无需真实标签的测试时训练方法，用多数投票伪标签路由样本，并结合自蒸馏与分组强化学习更新模型。它针对伪标签可能错误的问题，采用非对称目标：强化同意伪标签的轨迹，惩罚不同意伪标签且置信错误的轨迹。
key_points: 将同意多数投票结果的 rollouts 通过 On-Policy Self-Distillation 蒸馏，不同意的 rollouts 用 Grouped RL 进行惩罚，缓解错误伪标签污染问题
引入 token 级选择：蒸馏时降低已收敛位置权重，强化学习时只惩罚高置信错误 token
在无标签条件下，TTPO 在五个竞赛级数学基准上匹配有标签 OPSD，并将 Qwen3-1.7B 从 38.0% 提升到 45.2%
papers.why_notable: 这项工作把后训练中的强化学习和自蒸馏推进到无标签测试时训练场景，降低了对标注答案的依赖，并展示出较强的数学推理提升和跨任务泛化潜力。
papers.abstract: Recent prominent post-training methods, such as Reinforcement Learning (RL) and On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), have driven rapid progress in mathematical reasoning for large language models, yet their reliance on ground-truth labels precludes test-time training (TTT). Replacing ground truth with majority-vote pseudo-labels is a natural alternative, yet it is fragile: an incorrect vote corrupts the teacher and misleads every token. We observe that this failure mode is asymmetric: rollouts that disagree with the pseudo-label are typically wrong regardless of whether the vote itself is correct. Building on this observation, we propose Test-Time Policy Optimization (TTPO), an asymmetric objective that distills agreeing rollouts via OPSD and penalizes disagreeing rollouts with Grouped RL. Token-level selection further refines both branches: distillation down-weights already-converged positions, while RL penalizes only confident errors. Both updates remain well-grounded even under frequent pseudo-label errors, and majority-vote routing yields tighter self-supervision as the model improves. Without any labels, TTPO matches label-supervised OPSD on five competition-level benchmarks, raises Qwen3-1.7B from 38.0% to 45.2% in TTT, yields +25.2% to +36.4% without thinking, and shows strong cross-task generalization.

papers.title: PAWBench: How Far Are We from Probabilistically Aligned World Modeling?
papers.brief: 论文提出“概率对齐”作为世界模型的分布级评估标准，并构建 PAWBench 与 PAWEval，用重复视频生成来检验模型是否能恢复同一初始条件下多种物理结果的真实概率分布。
papers.tldr: 评测视频世界模型的概率分布对齐能力
papers.what_it_is: 论文提出“概率对齐”作为世界模型的分布级评估标准，并构建 PAWBench 与 PAWEval，用重复视频生成来检验模型是否能恢复同一初始条件下多种物理结果的真实概率分布。
key_points: 覆盖 50 个物理场景，评估 11 个当前视频生成系统作为随机世界动态采样器的能力
PAWEval 将多次视频 rollout 转换为物理行为结果的经验分布，而非只看单条视频是否合理
实验显示现有模型无法同时覆盖所有有效行为并匹配参考概率，语言提示、噪声采样和训练调整也难以完全修正
papers.why_notable: 它指出当前“视频生成即世界模型”评估中的关键盲区：不仅要生成合理视频，还要生成正确的可能性分布；这对物理仿真、规划和具身智能中的可靠世界建模具有重要意义。
papers.abstract: Recent video generation models are increasingly framed as world models. Many physical processes can unfold in more than one valid way. Therefore, a world model should reproduce not only a plausible trajectory, but also the distribution of possible behaviors under the same initial observation and action. We call this distribution-level requirement probabilistic alignment. However, existing evaluations largely assess individual-video plausibility and do not test whether repeated generations recover the correct distribution. This raises a central question: how far are current video generators from probabilistically aligned world modeling? To answer it, we formalize probabilistic alignment as a distributional criterion for world models and introduce PAWBench, a benchmark for evaluating video generators as stochastic samplers of world dynamics. We further introduce PAWEval, an outcome-level protocol that converts repeated video rollouts into empirical distributions over possible physical behaviors. Across 50 scenarios and eleven current systems, no model consistently matches the reference probabilities while recovering the range of valid behaviors. Having established this gap, we test whether language prompts, initial noise sampling, or model training can reshape the model's predictive distribution. We believe our work can serve as a foundation for future efforts to move towards probabilistically aligned world modeling.

papers.title: Understanding Evolution Strategies for LLM Reasoning: Broader Reasoning Coverage than GRPO
papers.brief: 本文系统研究进化策略（ES）用于LLM推理后训练的优化行为，并从理论与实验上解释其相对GRPO的优势边界。论文发现ES能带来更广的推理覆盖、更高Pass@K，并提出顺序GRPO-ES训练策略结合两者优势。
papers.tldr: ES比GRPO覆盖更广的LLM推理路径
papers.what_it_is: 本文系统研究进化策略（ES）用于LLM推理后训练的优化行为，并从理论与实验上解释其相对GRPO的优势边界。论文发现ES能带来更广的推理覆盖、更高Pass@K，并提出顺序GRPO-ES训练策略结合两者优势。
key_points: 理论上提出验证器投影的Jensen-Shannon多样性有助于提升Pass@K，解释ES群体多样性为何能改善推理覆盖。
实验发现GRPO容易出现熵坍缩，而ES在提升Pass@1的同时保持更高Pass@K，说明其能更充分挖掘预训练模型的多样推理能力。
ES虽导致全模型参数漂移，但性能增益主要来自少量大幅更新参数，呈现功能稀疏性，且不必然导致灾难性遗忘。
papers.why_notable: 该工作将ES从“省显存的GRPO替代品”重新定位为具有独特推理覆盖优势的后训练范式，并给出理论指标、训练策略和超参数规律，对LLM推理强化学习训练具有实用指导价值。
papers.abstract: Evolution Strategies (ES) have recently emerged as a memory-efficient post-training paradigm for LLM reasoning. However, the optimization behavior of ES remains understudied, making it hard to define its advantage scope compared to mainstream post-training paradigms (e.g., Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)). By systematically investigating ES dynamics and mechanisms, this paper first identifies a performance advantage of ES over GRPO, theoretically and empirically showing that ES can lead to broader reasoning coverage, thereby better exploiting the reasoning capabilities of pretrained LLMs. Theoretically, we show that verifier-projected Jensen-Shannon diversity across the ES population is helpful to higher Pass@K performances. Empirically, unlike GRPO, which exhibits entropy collapse, ES improves Pass@1 while attaining higher Pass@K than GRPO. We further develop a sequential GRPO-ES training strategy that combines GRPO's strength in Pass@1 with ES's gains in Pass@K. Second, we find that despite substantial whole-model parameter drift, the task-performance gains of ES are only contributed to a sparse subset of larger-magnitude updates. This functional sparsity suggests that large parameter movement need not imply widespread functional change, and held-out evaluations further show that it does not necessarily lead to catastrophic forgetting. Finally, we study how hyperparameter design affects the effectiveness of ES, demonstrating that ES requires a smaller population size in a larger LLM. These findings position ES as a distinct reasoning post-training paradigm rather than a less effective, memory-efficient alternative to GRPO.

papers.title: Magpie: Real-Time World Renderer for Interactive Games
papers.brief: Magpie 是一个面向交互式游戏的实时生成式世界渲染系统。它将游戏逻辑执行与视觉生成解耦，由游戏引擎维护规则和状态，Render Server 根据白盒帧生成最终画面。
papers.tldr: 用生成模型实时渲染可交互游戏世界
papers.what_it_is: Magpie 是一个面向交互式游戏的实时生成式世界渲染系统。它将游戏逻辑执行与视觉生成解耦，由游戏引擎维护规则和状态，Render Server 根据白盒帧生成最终画面。
key_points: 设计者仍在传统游戏引擎中定义场景、规则与交互，保证玩法可控、可复现
运行时由游戏引擎解析玩家动作并维护世界状态，生成模型只负责视觉输出
通过白盒帧作为中间表示，降低早期原型对完整美术资产、材质和光照制作的依赖
papers.why_notable: 该工作给出了将视频基础模型用于实时游戏渲染的系统级路径，有望显著降低游戏原型开发的美术成本，同时保留游戏规则的稳定性与可设计性。
papers.abstract: Modern game development relies heavily on conventional graphics pipelines. High-quality visual content requires modeling, material authoring, animation, lighting, effects, and runtime optimization, making asset production expensive and extending the development cycle of game prototypes. Recently, video foundation models are beginning to change film and video production, but games differ from linear media, they require not only continuous and realistic imagery, but also stable and reproducible gameplay rules, object states, and interaction outcomes. We present Magpie, a real-time generative world-rendering system for interactive games. Magpie separates gameplay execution from visual generation. Designers define scenes and rules in a game engine. At runtime, the Game Engine resolves player actions and maintains world state, while an independent Render Server generates visual output from white-box frames produced by the engine. Magpie provides a system-level implementation path for applying generative models to real-time game rendering. It preserves gameplay designability and reproducibility, and reduces the dependence of early game prototypes on complete visual assets.

papers.title: Scaling Graph Neural Networks for Friend Recommendation: Multi-Hash User Embeddings and Temporal Neighbor Sampling
papers.brief: 本文提出一个面向超大规模社交图的端到端GNN好友推荐排序系统，重点解决数亿用户、数百亿边场景下的节点表示与时间邻居采样瓶颈。系统结合多哈希用户ID嵌入与时间排序CSR采样，在保持效果的同时大幅降低存储和计算成本。
papers.tldr: 生产级GNN好友推荐显著提效增益
papers.what_it_is: 本文提出一个面向超大规模社交图的端到端GNN好友推荐排序系统，重点解决数亿用户、数百亿边场景下的节点表示与时间邻居采样瓶颈。系统结合多哈希用户ID嵌入与时间排序CSR采样，在保持效果的同时大幅降低存储和计算成本。
key_points: 多哈希ID嵌入将用户ID嵌入表规模减少超过98%，避免超过200GB的完整嵌入表，同时保持推荐排序质量。
采用按时间戳排序的CSR存储和二分搜索，将时间邻居采样复杂度从O(deg(v)+k)降至O(log(deg(v))+k)，适配高好友数用户。
在1.94亿用户、280亿边社交图上验证；线上A/B测试相较强生产基线带来16%推荐加好友增长和11.5%独立加好友用户增长。
papers.why_notable: 论文展示了GNN在真实超大规模社交推荐系统中的可落地方案，不仅有明确的系统优化与建模设计，还给出大规模离线消融和线上A/B收益，具有较强工业参考价值。
papers.abstract: Friend recommendation is inherently graph-structured: the relevance of a potential connection depends on multi-hop social context rather than user attributes alone. However, deploying message-passing GNNs on a production-scale social graph with hundreds of millions of users and tens of billions of edges requires addressing numerous modeling and systems challenges. We present a scalable end-to-end GNN ranking system for production social graphs, focusing on two design choices that are critical in this setting: multi-hash ID embeddings and temporal neighbor sampling. Multi-hash embeddings are common for high-cardinality features, but industrial GNN systems typically either ignore trainable IDs or accept full embedding tables, exceeding 200 GB for our graph. We integrate multi-hash as the primary node representation, reducing the ID-embedding table size by more than 98 percent while preserving ranking quality. Temporal neighbor sampling is well understood in principle, but existing implementations scan full adjacency lists, which is a non-starter for users with tens of thousands of friends. We implement timestamp-sorted CSR storage with binary search, reducing the per-node temporal sampling cost from $O(deg(v) + k)$ to $O(\log(deg(v)) + k)$. Beyond these components, we show that this combination scales and yields measurable production impact. On a graph with 194M users and 28B edges, offline ablations isolate each design choice's contribution. In an online A/B test, our system increases friend additions from recommendations by 16 percent and unique friend adders by 11.5 percent over a strong production baseline. We release our framework for distributed training and inference on large temporal graphs.

papers.title: Token-Level Advertising
papers.brief: 论文提出 Latent Advertiser Mixture Auction（LAMA），将广告主影响直接嵌入语言模型生成过程，在每个 token 层面进行潜在混合式分配与解码。该机制证明满足马尔可夫 DSIC 与个体理性，并可通过学习方法在线重构广告主报价信号。
papers.tldr: 提出面向生成式AI的逐Token广告拍卖机制
papers.what_it_is: 论文提出 Latent Advertiser Mixture Auction（LAMA），将广告主影响直接嵌入语言模型生成过程，在每个 token 层面进行潜在混合式分配与解码。该机制证明满足马尔可夫 DSIC 与个体理性，并可通过学习方法在线重构广告主报价信号。
key_points: 广告主报告局部续写价值，诱导各自的下一 token 策略，平台通过潜在混合分布生成内容并更新分配后验
理论上证明 LAMA 满足 Markov DSIC、IR，并接近最优 KL 正则化社会福利
在真实商业搜索查询划分上的概念验证实验显示，可提升平台福利和收入，同时保持用户可见回答质量
papers.why_notable: 该工作将广告机制从传统固定广告位推进到生成式内容内部，为搜索、问答和对话式 AI 中的“生成原生广告”提供了机制设计与学习实现框架，兼具理论保证和初步实证价值。
papers.abstract: Generative AI is transforming how people access information, challenging traditional advertising mechanisms built around predefined slots. Towards generation-native advertising, we propose the Latent Advertiser Mixture Auction (LAMA), a token-level advertising mechanism that embeds advertiser influence directly into the generation process. Advertisers report local continuation values that induce advertiser-specific next-token policies, from which the platform decodes through a latent mixture while updating an allocation posterior. We show that LAMA satisfies Markov DSIC and IR, and achieves near-optimal KL-regularized welfare. We further develop a learning-based implementation that reconstructs the required reports online from learned local advantages and root values. Proof-of-concept experiments on real-world commercial-search query splits show that LAMA improves platform welfare and revenue while maintaining user-facing response quality, providing initial evidence for the feasibility of generation-native advertising.

papers.title: Puro-2B: Poor Lab's Qwen2-1.5B Trained on RTX 5090 within $5090
papers.brief: 论文提出并开源 Puro-2B 预训练配方，用 RTX 5090 消费级 GPU 从零训练最高 1.4 万亿 token 的 2B 语言模型。最佳模型训练成本低于 6900 美元，性能接近 Qwen2.5-1.5B，并给出成本-性能缩放规律。
papers.tldr: 用消费级显卡低成本预训练2B语言模型
papers.what_it_is: 论文提出并开源 Puro-2B 预训练配方，用 RTX 5090 消费级 GPU 从零训练最高 1.4 万亿 token 的 2B 语言模型。最佳模型训练成本低于 6900 美元，性能接近 Qwen2.5-1.5B，并给出成本-性能缩放规律。
key_points: 通过 FP8 低精度训练、硬件选择、Hyperball 优化、课程模型平均和数据配方降低预训练成本
在 Puro-2B 系列上拟合 Puro Cost Scaling Law，估计约 4400 美元即可达到 Qwen2-1.5B 性能
完整开源数据、代码、训练配方与模型权重，支持研究者复现和分析预训练数据课程对后训练表现的影响
papers.why_notable: 这项工作把从零预训练小型大语言模型的成本降到数千美元级别，显著降低学术界和开源社区参与基础模型训练研究的门槛，并提供可控的端到端预训练实验基准。
papers.abstract: Language model pretraining has become almost synonymous with prohibitive cost, placing it out of reach for much of the academic and open-source communities. Although strong open-source efforts already exist, including open-weight models and open-source training recipes, a cost-efficient, hardware-accessible, and open-source pretraining recipe has long been missing. Even at a small scale, training Llama-3.2-3B costs over \$1.5M, and reproducing SmolLM3-3B needs over \$700K. In this report, we present an open pretraining recipe designed to lower this barrier. Using this recipe, we train a collection of Puro-2B models from scratch on up to 1.4 trillion tokens with FP8 precision on consumer-grade RTX 5090 GPUs. The models in the collection differ in token budgets and selected recipe variants. Our best model is trained at a compute cost of less than \$6.9K and approaches Qwen2.5-1.5B performance under our evaluation protocol. This cost efficiency is enabled by a combination of approaches, including hardware selection, low-precision training, hyperball optimization, curriculum model averaging, and the data recipe. Beyond the recipe itself, we provide two additional results. First, across the Puro-2B collection, we derive a Puro Cost Scaling Law that relates training cost to average model performance; the fitted law suggests that about \$4.4K, less than \$5,090, is sufficient to reach the performance of Qwen2-1.5B. Second, as an end-to-end case study, we examine how pretraining data curricula shape downstream performance after post-training. Such controlled studies are enabled by having access to the full pretraining pipeline rather than model weights alone. We release the full training recipe for Puro-2B, including data, code, and model weights under Apache 2.0 at https://huggingface.co/collections/thu-pacman/puro-2b.

papers.title: LLMs Can Design Near-Optimal OR Algorithms
papers.brief: 论文评估前沿 LLM 在库存控制、排队网络控制和品类优化等明确运筹问题中的算法设计能力。结果显示，最强模型仅凭未调参提示和 Python 沙盒，就能生成接近甚至超过专门方法的解法或通用算法。
papers.tldr: LLM可为运筹问题设计近最优算法
papers.what_it_is: 论文评估前沿 LLM 在库存控制、排队网络控制和品类优化等明确运筹问题中的算法设计能力。结果显示，最强模型仅凭未调参提示和 Python 沙盒，就能生成接近甚至超过专门方法的解法或通用算法。
key_points: 区分两种使用层级：Level 1 针对单个实例直接求解，Level 2 仅根据问题类描述生成可泛化到实例参数的算法。
人工干预极少：使用同一个未调参提示，并限制 Python 沙盒计算预算。
gpt-5.6-sol 在几乎所有评测实例上匹配或超过现有最佳方法，且模型代际进步在不到八个月内显著提升。
papers.why_notable: 该研究表明，前沿 LLM 已能成为明确运筹优化问题中严肃的经验基线，不只是辅助编码，而是能自动设计具有竞争力的算法，可能改变运筹算法开发与基准评测方式。
papers.abstract: We ask whether large language models (LLMs) can design effective algorithms for well-specified operations research (OR) problems. We study inventory control, queueing network control, and assortment optimization. We evaluate two levels of LLM use: at level 1, the model receives one problem instance and returns a solution for that instance; at level 2, it receives only the problem class description and broad parameter ranges, and returns an algorithm that maps instance parameters to solutions. Human input is minimal: we give one untuned prompt that describes the problem, and the model has access to a Python sandbox tool with a fixed compute budget. The strongest model we test, gpt-5.6-sol, matches or outperforms the best existing method on almost all evaluated instances. This holds even at level 2, where the returned algorithm is fixed before seeing the evaluation instances. Performance also improves sharply across models released less than eight months apart, suggesting that this capability is moving quickly. Thus, for the well-specified operations problems we study, a single untuned LLM query can already produce algorithms competitive with specialized methods. These results suggest that frontier LLMs can be a serious empirical baseline for algorithm design in well-specified OR problems.

papers.title: Enforcing Dirichlet Boundary Conditions in Operator Learning
papers.brief: 本文提出一种神经算子架构，使每层输出都位于输出域上满足齐次Dirichlet条件的拉普拉斯特征函数子空间中，从而在训练无关的情况下严格满足边界条件。该方法适用于有界Lipschitz边界的一般几何与任意网格，并保持核积分神经算子的表达能力。
papers.tldr: 用拉普拉斯特征函数严格满足Dirichlet边界
papers.what_it_is: 本文提出一种神经算子架构，使每层输出都位于输出域上满足齐次Dirichlet条件的拉普拉斯特征函数子空间中，从而在训练无关的情况下严格满足边界条件。该方法适用于有界Lipschitz边界的一般几何与任意网格，并保持核积分神经算子的表达能力。
key_points: 通过限制层输出落在齐次Dirichlet拉普拉斯特征函数张成空间中，显式强制边界值为零
不依赖均匀网格、光滑边界或盒状可分离区域，可用于任意网格数据和复杂几何
证明了该架构的通用逼近性，并将分析推广到一大类核积分神经算子
papers.why_notable: 该工作解决了神经算子中已知边界条件通常只能由数据间接学习的问题，在严格物理约束、复杂几何和任意离散化之间取得兼容，对PDE科学机器学习具有较强实用价值。
papers.abstract: Operator learning in scientific machine learning is concerned with approximation of maps between infinite-dimensional function spaces; such maps frequently arise as the solution operators of partial differential equations (PDEs). Neural operators have demonstrated broad empirical success at approximating such maps from data. However, most existing neural operator architectures enforce boundary conditions indirectly through training from data even though the boundary condition is often known exactly. Furthermore, existing modifications and approaches that do enforce boundary conditions explicitly suffer from impractical restrictions, including boundary smoothness, uniform grids, and separable, box-like domains. In this work, we propose an architecture which, independently of training, satisfies homogeneous Dirichlet boundary conditions, whilst simultaneously retaining the expressivity of existing kernel-integral neural operator architectures. This is achieved by enforcing the property that the output of each layer is contained in the span of a subset of the homogeneous Dirichlet eigenfunctions of the Laplacian on the output domain. The method requires only that the output domain be bounded with Lipschitz boundary and places no restriction on the choice of discretization, making it applicable to arbitrary mesh data and general geometries. We prove universal approximation for the resulting architecture; furthermore the approach we adopt in the analysis proves universality for a broad class of kernel-integral neural operators thereby uniting existing theory for a variety of operator learning methods. We validate the proposed method on maps defined by the coefficient to solution map in 2D PDEs: Darcy flow on a square domain and the Helmholtz equation on a circular domain. Comparisons are made with alternative methods.

papers.title: Aphanta: Diagnosing Task-Aligned Image-Edited Intermediates for Multimodal Reasoning
papers.brief: 论文提出 Aphanta，一个自动任务发现与闭环诊断框架，用于评估 MLLM→图像编辑器→MLLM 流程中的显式视觉中间态是否真正帮助推理。它通过对比直接推理、编辑器生成中间态推理和理想参考中间态推理，区分潜在收益与当前编辑器的实际可用性。
papers.tldr: 诊断图像编辑中间态对多模态推理的真实价值
papers.what_it_is: 论文提出 Aphanta，一个自动任务发现与闭环诊断框架，用于评估 MLLM→图像编辑器→MLLM 流程中的显式视觉中间态是否真正帮助推理。它通过对比直接推理、编辑器生成中间态推理和理想参考中间态推理，区分潜在收益与当前编辑器的实际可用性。
key_points: 在20类候选任务和多种图像编辑器—MLLM组合上评测，发现视觉中间态的收益高度依赖任务类型
收益主要集中在视觉线索注入、视觉 grounding 和反事实状态实现等任务
对符号敏感构造或结构外推类中间态，当前图像编辑器可靠性明显不足；正向任务子集上 Qwen 管线平均分从0.343提升到0.445
papers.why_notable: 该工作系统性揭示了图像编辑并非通用多模态推理机制，而更像特定任务下的视觉工作区；Aphanta 提供了可复用协议，用于评估任务、视觉表示、编辑器实现能力与下游推理收益之间的匹配关系。
papers.abstract: Explicit visual intermediates can help multimodal large language models (MLLMs) externalize spatial evidence and updated visual states, but their utility depends on whether an image editor can faithfully realize the required transformation. We introduce \textbf{Aphanta}, an automated task-discovery and closed-loop diagnostic framework for the MLLM -> image editor -> MLLM pipeline. Aphanta evaluates three conditions---direct reasoning, reasoning with an editor-generated intermediate, and reasoning with an idealized reference intermediate---to separate potential visual headroom from the practical utility of current editors. Across 20 candidate tasks and multiple editor--MLLM combinations, we find that utility is strongly task-conditioned. Gains concentrate in visual cue injection, grounding, and counterfactual state realization, whereas intermediates requiring symbol-sensitive construction or structural extrapolation are substantially less reliable. On the selected positive-task subset, our consolidated Qwen pipeline improves the mean task score from 0.343 to 0.445 ($+10.2$ points; $+29.7\%$ relative), while the full study also retains filtered and unsuccessful tasks to expose the boundary. These results position image editing as a specialized visual workspace rather than a universal reasoning mechanism, and establish Aphanta as a reusable protocol for measuring task--representation alignment, editor realization, and downstream pipeline utility.

papers.title: Learning a Continuous Sepsis Severity Score Without Hour-by-Hour Supervision: A Two-Site Retrospective Study
papers.brief: 本文基于两家医院的回顾性脓毒症队列，利用72小时治疗窗口内43个常规临床变量，学习一个0-10分的连续脓毒症严重度指数。方法不把死亡率当作每个时刻的直接标签，而是作为治疗轨迹级排序信号，将预后信息非均匀分配到不同时间点。
papers.tldr: 无需逐小时标注学习连续脓毒症严重度评分
papers.what_it_is: 本文基于两家医院的回顾性脓毒症队列，利用72小时治疗窗口内43个常规临床变量，学习一个0-10分的连续脓毒症严重度指数。方法不把死亡率当作每个时刻的直接标签，而是作为治疗轨迹级排序信号，将预后信息非均匀分配到不同时间点。
key_points: 研究纳入两站点共29,116名和7,691名符合Sepsis-3标准的成人患者，并使用固定20%测试集评估。
在相同基线SOFA-2、乳酸、平均动脉压和肌酐分层内，死亡患者评分比存活患者高1.19-1.64分。
评分变化与乳酸变化相关性较强（Spearman ρ=0.39），跨机构模型一致性达到同站点相关性的70%-77%。
papers.why_notable: 传统脓毒症评分依赖固定变量和几十年前设定的权重，而该研究展示了可从真实患者轨迹中学习动态、连续、小时级预后评分的可行性，有望作为临床决策支持工具补充医生判断。
papers.abstract: Currently used sepsis severity indices rely on fixed variables and weights established decades ago, which are coarsely discretized and calibrated to a cohort that no longer reflects contemporary critical care. No alternative learned directly from patient trajectories is in routine use. We conducted a retrospective two-cohort study on a total of 29,116 and 7,691 adult patients meeting Sepsis-3 criteria from two hospital systems in Massachusetts and Georgie, respectively. We developed a sepsis index using 43 routinely charted variables over a 72-hour treatment window. Unlike previous studies, we use mortality as a treatment-level ranking signal rather than a per-state target, allowing credit to be redistributed non-uniformly across timesteps. Evaluation was done on a permanent 20% test holdout, using clinical vignettes and Spearman correlation. Uncertainty intervals were obtained by bootstrap resampling of whole patients. Under this ranking scheme, non-survivors scored 1.19-1.64 points higher than survivors on a 0-10 scale within all strata of baseline SOFA-2, with similar results stratifying within lactate, mean arterial pressure (MAP), and creatinine. Within-patient change in the index correlated with change in lactate (Spearman rho = 0.39; n = 1,854). Similar, weaker correlations were found for MAP and creatinine. On a cohort level, cross-institutional agreement measured by Spearman correlation between models trained on different sites, were 70-77% of same-site correlation. External within-patient correlations were 0.54 and 0.59 against ceilings of 0.92 and 0.90. Our index also correlated with established indices, while null controls stayed near zero. Our index demonstrated hourly prognostic information that meaningfully separates patient outcomes and is consistent with clinical expectation, indicating potential as a decision support tool complementing clinical judgement.

papers.title: How Language Models Organize and Structure Moral Knowledge
papers.brief: 论文用线性探针分析开源语言模型中六类道德基础的表征方向，研究LLM是否仅检测“道德性”或能区分不同道德维度。结果发现这些方向既不坍缩为单一探测器，也非彼此独立，而是在多维空间中共享一个道德特异的公共成分。
papers.tldr: LLM道德知识呈共享且多维的几何结构
papers.what_it_is: 论文用线性探针分析开源语言模型中六类道德基础的表征方向，研究LLM是否仅检测“道德性”或能区分不同道德维度。结果发现这些方向既不坍缩为单一探测器，也非彼此独立，而是在多维空间中共享一个道德特异的公共成分。
key_points: 六个Moral Foundations Theory类别的探针方向呈近最大独立维度，同时具有正向共享成分，非道德概念对照中几乎不存在这种共享结构
该几何结构跨模型架构与规模稳定，并在预训练早期即形成，早于探针准确率饱和
模型表征更符合语料统计而非MFT中的individualizing/binding划分；道德困境表征可部分由基础道德维度组合，但大部分方差编码冲突特异结构
papers.why_notable: 这项工作从表示几何角度揭示LLM内部如何组织道德概念，超越了简单的道德内容检测，有助于理解模型价值观、伦理推理与对齐机制的内部基础。
papers.abstract: How do large language models (LLMs) organize moral knowledge? Models detect moral content broadly, but detection is a low bar. We ask whether they go further, distinguishing moral foundations from one another and organizing the relationships between them geometrically. We train six independent linear probes on open-weight language models, one per Moral Foundations Theory (MFT) category (care/harm, fair/cheat, lib/oppress, loy/betray, auth/subv, sanc/degrade), and examine how the resulting directions relate to each other in representation space. We find the directions neither collapse into a single moral detector nor isolate from one another. Rather, they span a near-maximal number of independent dimensions while sharing a positive common component. The shared component is the signature of integration, and it is moral-specific relative to a matched non-moral concept battery built identically (mean pairwise cosine 0.26 vs. 0.013). The geometry is consistent across architectures and scale and reaches its integration regime early in pre-training, well before probe accuracy saturates. The structure the model discovers shows no evidence of the individualizing/binding distinction predicted by Moral Foundations Theory (an underpowered test: only 20 candidate partitions exist) but rather reflects corpus statistics. Extending to moral dilemmas, each dilemma direction partially composes from its component foundations, at 2.7x a mismatched-pair baseline, while the majority of its variance encodes conflict-specific structure. The model represents moral tension itself, not a pre-resolved judgment.

papers.title: CorporateBench: Large-Scale Q&A Benchmarking with Temporal Knowledge Bases
papers.brief: 论文提出 CorporateBench，一个人工验证的多任务问答基准，用于评估大语言模型在企业级文档集合上的信息抽取与知识库查询能力。其语料来自随时间演化的合成企业知识库，规模最高超过23万份文档。
papers.tldr: 面向企业通信推理的大规模问答基准
papers.what_it_is: 论文提出 CorporateBench，一个人工验证的多任务问答基准，用于评估大语言模型在企业级文档集合上的信息抽取与知识库查询能力。其语料来自随时间演化的合成企业知识库，规模最高超过23万份文档。
key_points: 构建4个合成公司场景，员工规模从12人到1万人，模拟真实企业通信网络
基于时间演化知识库生成文档，保证跨文档、跨时间的逻辑一致性
评测5个大语言模型，发现随着输入规模接近真实企业场景，模型性能显著下降
papers.why_notable: 它填补了企业内部通信与大规模文档推理评测的空白，在不泄露真实企业数据的前提下提供更接近实际部署难度的基准。
papers.abstract: LLMs are increasingly able to answer complex questions about enterprise-scale document collections. But evaluation is hard: companies don't want to share internal communications, and synthetic datasets have been overly simple. We present CorporateBench (CB), a human-validated multi-task Q&A benchmark whose scale approaches the conditions LLMs encounter in corporate communication networks, with evaluation corpora surpassing 230,000 documents. CB evaluates LLMs across two dimensions (information extraction and knowledge base querying) through four synthetically generated firms ranging from 12 to 10,000 employees. Each corpus is sampled from a temporally evolving knowledge base describing a consistent world, guaranteeing cross-document logical consistency even across hundreds of thousands of documents. We evaluate five LLMs on CB, revealing increasingly poor performance as input size approaches realistic scales. CB provides LLM developers a metric for corporate communication reasoning, filling a crucial gap in the benchmarking ecosystem.

papers.title: Universality and sharp thresholds for ellipsoid fitting
papers.brief: 论文证明了高维随机向量椭球拟合问题的尖锐相变：当样本数与维度平方成比例时，存在显式可满足性阈值。低于阈值时高概率存在正定椭球穿过所有点，高于阈值时连半正定拟合也不存在，并给出不可满足区间的最优平方拟合误差。
papers.tldr: 随机数据椭球拟合存在四阶矩普适阈值
papers.what_it_is: 论文证明了高维随机向量椭球拟合问题的尖锐相变：当样本数与维度平方成比例时，存在显式可满足性阈值。低于阈值时高概率存在正定椭球穿过所有点，高于阈值时连半正定拟合也不存在，并给出不可满足区间的最优平方拟合误差。
key_points: 研究对象为坐标独立、零均值、单位方差、共同四阶矩的次高斯随机向量
阈值仅依赖坐标分布的共同四阶矩，揭示椭球拟合中的四阶矩普适性
对标准高斯数据证明阈值为 1/4，解决了椭球拟合猜想
papers.why_notable: 该结果给出了随机几何/高维统计中椭球插值问题的完整相变图景，并将阈值从高斯情形推广到广泛的次高斯分布，具有明确的理论突破意义。
papers.abstract: We establish a sharp phase transition for fitting random vectors by an ellipsoid. The random vectors have independent subgaussian coordinates with mean zero, variance one, and a common fourth moment, and the number of vectors is proportional to the square of the dimension. We identify an explicit satisfiability threshold such that, with high probability, a positive definite ellipsoid passes through every data point below the threshold, whereas no positive semidefinite fit exists above it. We also determine the optimal squared fitting error throughout the unsatisfiable regime. In particular, the threshold depends on the coordinate distributions only through their common fourth moment, revealing a fourth moment universality phenomenon. For standard Gaussian data the threshold is $1/4$, resolving the ellipsoid fitting conjecture.

papers.title: Beyond Parallel Blindness: Information Floors and Model Gaps in Block Drafting
papers.brief: 本文研究块草稿器一次前向生成多个 token 时的拒绝来源，提出“信息下限”来区分块内路径信息缺失带来的不可避免拒绝与模型建模不足造成的额外差距。作者在多个领域、开源模型和前沿 API 目标模型上估计两者，并分析短程条件信息对接受率的影响。
papers.tldr: 量化块草稿解码中的信息缺失与模型差距
papers.what_it_is: 本文研究块草稿器一次前向生成多个 token 时的拒绝来源，提出“信息下限”来区分块内路径信息缺失带来的不可避免拒绝与模型建模不足造成的额外差距。作者在多个领域、开源模型和前沿 API 目标模型上估计两者，并分析短程条件信息对接受率的影响。
key_points: 提出信息下限：在给定条件顺序下，理论上最小的期望拒绝率；超过该下限的部分定义为模型差距。
实验显示全并行设置下，Qwen3-4B 最后位置的信息下限达 0.286，即使最优提议器单位置接受率也最多约 71%。
只实现一个前序 token 就能消除 86%–100% 的信息下限，说明块内依赖高度局部；但现有 DFlash、DSpark 仍显著高于各自下限。
papers.why_notable: 这项工作为投机解码/块并行草稿的瓶颈提供了可分解的评估框架，说明提升接受率不能只看平均接受长度，还要区分信息结构限制与提议模型质量，有助于设计更高效的短程条件草稿器。
papers.abstract: Block drafters propose several tokens in one forward pass, before earlier target tokens are realised. Their rejection mixes two losses: missing within-block path information and imperfect modelling of observable information. Accepted length cannot distinguish them. We separate the two with an information floor, the minimum expected rejection at a specified conditioning order; rejection above this floor is the model gap. Estimating both from target rollouts across four domains, four open-weight targets, and a frontier API target yields three findings. First, the all-parallel floor reaches $0.286$ at the final slot on Qwen3-4B, limiting even the best proposal to $71\%$ per-slot acceptance. Second, one realised token removes $86$--$100\%$ of this floor, a locality also recovered by an independent mutual-information analysis. Third, current drafters remain far above their floors: the final-slot model gap accounts for $43$--$64\%$ of DFlash rejection and $85$--$92\%$ of DSpark's oracle-conditioned rejection. These findings separate the value of short-range conditioning from proposal quality.

papers.title: A Finite Sample Analysis for Quantile Temporal Difference Learning in Distributional Reinforcement Learning
papers.brief: 本文分析表格分布式强化学习中的同步分位数时序差分学习（QTD），建立了从任意初始化出发的全局有限样本收敛保证。证明将全局稳定性与局部随机波动分离，刻画了步长下最后迭代误差的主导阶。
papers.tldr: 给出QTD学习全局有限样本保证
papers.what_it_is: 本文分析表格分布式强化学习中的同步分位数时序差分学习（QTD），建立了从任意初始化出发的全局有限样本收敛保证。证明将全局稳定性与局部随机波动分离，刻画了步长下最后迭代误差的主导阶。
key_points: 利用奖励分布函数的序单调性和分布式Bellman算子的W∞收缩性，将任意初始化迭代带入局部邻域
在局部邻域线性化QTD平均场，证明其Jacobian为非奇异M矩阵，并借助正半群进行方差敏感鞅分析
对步长α_t=c(t+1)^(-a)，a∈(1/2,1)，最后迭代随机波动为约O(T^(-a/2)/√(1-γ))，且不随分位数数量呈多项式增长
papers.why_notable: 该工作为分布式强化学习中常用的分位数TD方法提供了严格有限样本理论，清晰区分了局部随机误差与全局样本复杂度，有助于理解分位数数量、折扣因子和目标密度对学习稳定性的影响。
papers.abstract: We establish a global finite-sample guarantee for synchronous quantile temporal-difference learning (QTD) in tabular distributional reinforcement learning. The proof separates two stability mechanisms. A global comparison argument, based on the order monotonicity of reward cumulative distribution functions and the $W_\infty$ contraction of the distributional Bellman operator, brings an arbitrarily initialized iterate into a local neighborhood. Inside that neighborhood, we linearize the QTD mean field. Its Jacobian is a nonsingular $M$-matrix, and the associated positive semigroup permits a variance-sensitive martingale analysis. For stepsizes $α_t=c(t+1)^{-a}$ with $a\in(1/2,1)$, the leading last-iterate fluctuation is of order $\widetilde O\bigl(T^{-a/2}/\sqrt{1-γ}\bigr)$ and has no polynomial dependence on the number of quantiles. The deterministic transient and the required burn-in can still depend on the smallest Bellman-target density, which is of order $m^{-1}$ in the worst case. The result therefore distinguishes sharply between the local stochastic fluctuation and the global sample complexity.

papers.title: QuantumBoostNet: A Hybrid Classical-Quantum Architecture for Enhanced Accuracy in Cardiac Ultrasound View Identification
papers.brief: 论文提出 QuantumBoostNet，一种用于心脏超声视图识别的混合经典-量子架构。模型在经典视觉骨干上接入经典头与10量子比特参数化量子头，并通过两阶段训练和自适应混合机制提升分类表现。
papers.tldr: 混合量子模型提升心超视图识别精度
papers.what_it_is: 论文提出 QuantumBoostNet，一种用于心脏超声视图识别的混合经典-量子架构。模型在经典视觉骨干上接入经典头与10量子比特参数化量子头，并通过两阶段训练和自适应混合机制提升分类表现。
key_points: 采用双头结构：经典分类头与参数化10量子比特量子电路头协同工作
训练过程分两阶段，并用基于损失动态的混合参数自适应切换/融合两类预测头
在心脏超声视图识别、通用图像分类基准和噪声鲁棒性实验中均优于多种经典及混合量子模型
papers.why_notable: 该工作展示了混合经典-量子模型在高噪声、专业医学影像任务中的潜在优势，为量子机器学习在实际临床辅助诊断场景中的应用提供了新的实验证据。
papers.abstract: Accurate identification of the correct view or angle in cardiac ultrasound (echocardiogram) is a critical component of cardiologic imaging. This step is essential for precise anatomical interpretation, reliable measurement, and the reduction of clinical errors. Although computer vision has advanced significantly, most state-of-the-art models perform well on standard benchmarks but often yield suboptimal results in specialized medical imaging tasks due to the high level of noise present in the data. QuantumBoostNet, a hybrid classical-quantum architecture, is introduced to address these challenges. This model integrates a classical backbone with two heads: one classical and one quantum, with the quantum head implemented as a parametrized 10-qubit quantum circuit. Training occurs in two stages, with an adaptive transition between heads governed by a mixing parameter that monitors loss dynamics. Extensive experiments indicate that, despite the limited number of qubits that can be simulated, QuantumBoostNet consistently outperforms state-of-the-art classical and hybrid classical-quantum models in cardiac ultrasound view identification, achieving a relative improvement over the best competitor. QuantumBoostNet also demonstrates superior performance on established image classification benchmarks and exhibits robustness to noise. These findings support the continued development of hybrid classical-quantum models for specialized medical imaging applications.

papers.title: Recovering Expert Critic-Sourced Network Adjacency between Musical Artists from Acoustic Distributions: A Construct-Validity Approach
papers.brief: 论文将专家乐评中显式关联的艺术家关系视为推荐信号，并用艺术家的声学特征分布检验其外部构念效度。通过最优传输距离建模艺术家间声学接近性，评估这些乐评邻接关系在冷启动场景下能否被音乐内容恢复。
papers.tldr: 用声学分布验证乐评关系可恢复
papers.what_it_is: 论文将专家乐评中显式关联的艺术家关系视为推荐信号，并用艺术家的声学特征分布检验其外部构念效度。通过最优传输距离建模艺术家间声学接近性，评估这些乐评邻接关系在冷启动场景下能否被音乐内容恢复。
key_points: 用80维 Essentia 低层声学描述符将艺术家表示为经验分布，并以 Wasserstein 距离刻画两两接近度
在艺术家不重叠的冷启动划分下，集成模型恢复乐评邻接边的样本外 AUC 达0.767，95%置信区间为0.761-0.775
恢复能力随评论共识单调提升，多来源共同确认的边 AUC 达0.865；场景化、边界清晰的流派比宽泛产业标签更易恢复
papers.why_notable: 该研究为“专家乐评关系”作为音乐推荐信号提供了声学层面的外部验证，说明其既包含可由音频内容复现的“声学核心”，也包含社会叙事和文化定位等信息；对冷启动音乐推荐和音乐信息检索具有实用价值。
papers.abstract: Music recommendation relies primarily on two signals: user-item interactions, which fail in the cold-start regime, and intrinsic musical content, available for any recording. We argue that a third, largely untapped signal is both richer and more principled: critical adjacency, the pairwise relation established when an expert critic explicitly links two artists in long-form prose. It encodes deliberate judgments about which artists belong together. Prior work established its internal validity, showing it recovers coherent, interpretable communities and can match collaborative filtering in user-satisfaction simulations, with no user data. What has been missing is external validation: whether this critic-sourced relation is grounded in the music itself versus sociological context. We test it against acoustic content, reframing the question as one of construct validity. Representing artists as empirical distributions over 80 low-level Essentia acoustic descriptors and modeling pairwise proximity via marginal optimal-transport (Wasserstein) distances, we evaluate how far critical adjacency is sonically recoverable under a cold-start, artist-disjoint split. Our ensemble recovers these edges at out-of-sample AUC of 0.767 (95% CI 0.761-0.775). Recoverability rises monotonically with critical consensus, reaching 0.865 on multi-source attested edges. Stratified evaluations align with sociological models of genre: tightly bounded, scene-based genres show higher recoverability than broad industry umbrella terms. Critical discourse is thus a rich source of information for recommendation, decomposing into a reproducible "sonic core" and a "sociological remainder" driven by narrative positioning, subcultural context, and canonical placement. The work offers both a scalable cold-start discovery mechanism and a sociologically grounded approach to MIR and MRS research.

papers.title: MM-Spectrum: Multimodal Multi-spectral Molecular Structural Elucidation with a Stable MoE Framework
papers.brief: 论文提出 MM-Spectrum，一个面向多模态多光谱“谱图到分子结构解析”的稀疏 Mixture-of-Experts 框架。它针对直接拼接异构光谱导致的模态不平衡和性能下降问题，设计更稳定的跨模态融合机制。
papers.tldr: 用稳定MoE融合多光谱推断分子结构
papers.what_it_is: 论文提出 MM-Spectrum，一个面向多模态多光谱“谱图到分子结构解析”的稀疏 Mixture-of-Experts 框架。它针对直接拼接异构光谱导致的模态不平衡和性能下降问题，设计更稳定的跨模态融合机制。
key_points: 引入显式模态感知路由，将光谱模态身份与 token 内容表示共同提供给路由器，缓解多光谱异构带来的专家分配失衡。
结合共享专家与交互专家，分别捕获模态通用信息、模态特有信息和跨模态协同信息。
采用异构专家容量以适配不同光谱模态的信息量差异，并在全模态、双模态、缺失模态场景下均取得稳定提升。
papers.why_notable: 该工作解决了多光谱分子结构解析中常见的“简单拼接反而退化”问题，为化学谱图多模态融合提供了更稳健、可解释的 MoE 方案，具有实际科研和药物发现应用价值。
papers.abstract: Inferring molecular structures from multimodal spectroscopic measurements requires integrating complementary yet highly heterogeneous signals. However, the common paradigm of directly concatenating multispectral sequences can exhibit anomalous performance degradation, primarily due to pronounced heterogeneity and the resulting multimodal imbalance across modalities. As a remedy, we propose MM-Spectrum, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts framework tailored for multimodal multispectral spectra-to-structure elucidation. To better match the information characteristics under multispectral imbalance, MM-Spectrum introduces an explicit modality-aware routing mechanism that exposes spectral identity to the router in addition to token content representations. Moreover, it incorporates shared and interaction experts, together with heterogeneous expert capacities, to extract multispectral modality-unique and cross-modal synergistic information while suppressing noise-induced interference. Across full-modality, bimodal, and missing-modality settings on molecular structural elucidation, MM-Spectrum achieves consistent and substantial improvements, supported by ablation studies and interpretability analyses.

papers.title: Making Latent Evolution Explicit: Operator-Structured Transitions for World Action Models
papers.brief: 论文提出 Latent Evolution Operator Network（LEON），用于在潜表示空间中建模机器人交互下的场景状态演化。它将潜变量转移从常见 Transformer 预测器改为基于受控 Koopman 生成元思想的算子传播与加性 forcing 组合。
papers.tldr: 用算子结构改进机器人潜空间世界模型
papers.what_it_is: 论文提出 Latent Evolution Operator Network（LEON），用于在潜表示空间中建模机器人交互下的场景状态演化。它将潜变量转移从常见 Transformer 预测器改为基于受控 Koopman 生成元思想的算子传播与加性 forcing 组合。
key_points: 将“转移实现方式”从表示学习和策略耦合中独立出来研究，强调其本身是影响 WAM 性能的关键架构选择
LEON 在学习到的可观测空间中使用上下文调制的共享演化算子，并保留加性变化通路以处理外部驱动或突变
在受控动力系统和两类 latent WAM 策略集成方式中，LEON 提升闭环控制性能与鲁棒性，并可完全替换原有转移模块
papers.why_notable: 该工作为 latent world action model 引入更符合时间演化结构的归纳偏置，挑战了仅用 Transformer 做潜空间转移的默认选择，对机器人世界模型和闭环控制有直接实用价值。
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) augment robot policies by predicting how task-relevant scene states may evolve under interaction. Recent WAMs increasingly perform such prediction in latent representation spaces, avoiding full appearance-level generation while preserving control-relevant information. Yet latent transitions are commonly realized with Transformer-based predictors whose inductive structure is centered on token interaction rather than temporal evolution. We study transition realization as an architectural choice distinct from predictive representation and prediction-policy coupling. We introduce the Latent Evolution Operator Network (LEON), which models latent evolution in a learned observable space through context-modulated operator-based propagation and additive forcing. Grounded in the controlled Koopman generator view of evolution, LEON organizes context-dependent transition variation around a shared evolution-operator structure while retaining a complementary path for additive change. Controlled dynamical systems verify the resulting evolution-specific inductive bias and the complementary roles of operator propagation and forcing. Across two WAM formulations that integrate latent prediction into the policy differently, LEON improves closed-loop performance and robustness while remaining effective under full transition replacement. These results establish transition realization as a consequential architectural choice in latent WAMs.

papers.title: Circuit Condensation: Post-Training that Concentrates a Behavior's Causal Circuit
papers.brief: 论文提出 Circuit Condensation：一种面向机制可解释性的后训练方法，通过剪除低归因边并训练低秩适配器，让特定行为集中到更小的因果电路中。实验显示该方法能在保持任务表现和通用能力的同时，显著缩小可解释电路规模。
papers.tldr: 通过后训练压缩模型行为的因果电路
papers.what_it_is: 论文提出 Circuit Condensation：一种面向机制可解释性的后训练方法，通过剪除低归因边并训练低秩适配器，让特定行为集中到更小的因果电路中。实验显示该方法能在保持任务表现和通用能力的同时，显著缩小可解释电路规模。
key_points: 每轮先剪除低归因连接，再训练 LoRA 匹配原模型在剩余电路上的行为，并仅在性能不退化时保留剪枝结果
在4类行为、8个模型的32个设置中，30个设置优于最强冻结基线，平均电路缩小8.1倍，最高316倍
子集穷举与成对消融发现部分电路不可再缩减，并揭示边之间存在依赖关系，不能简单独立解释
papers.why_notable: 该工作把机制可解释性中的“大而难检验”的冻结电路，转化为更小、更可验证的充分子电路，有助于系统性分析模型内部机制及错误来源。
papers.abstract: One approach to mechanistic interpretability explains behavior through circuits: the components and connections that carry it. Frozen discovery often returns hundreds of edges, making them hard to inspect, compare, or verify exhaustively. We introduce Circuit Condensation, which post-trains models to concentrate behaviors into smaller causal graphs. Each round prunes low-attribution edges and trains a low-rank adapter to match the original through what remains, retaining the cut only if task performance and general capability survive. Across four behaviors and eight models, condensed circuits are smaller than the strongest frozen baseline in 30 of 32 settings, by $8.1\times$ on average and up to $316\times$. Repeating the search without weight updates produces larger circuits in 29 of 32 settings, showing that weight updates, rather than search alone, drive the reduction. Testing every subset of 19 circuits finds 11 that cannot be reduced and reveals removable edges in the rest. Pair ablations expose dependencies between edges, showing that their effects cannot be understood independently. On indirect object identification, condensation isolates 24 heads, 17 of them with documented roles, against 61 heads and 36 undocumented ones for the matched frozen circuit: a sufficient sub-circuit of the published mechanism rather than a reconstruction of it. The resulting circuit tracks the original model's next-token distribution and predicts its errors.

papers.title: Importance Scoring of Transformer Attention Heads in Learning Tabular Data
papers.brief: 论文将注意力头重要性评分用于表格数据上的多头Transformer解释与优化，并在40个表格数据集上验证。结果显示，按低重要性头逐步删除通常对性能影响最小，而先删除高重要性头会显著降低分类性能。
papers.tldr: 用重要性评分解释并裁剪表格Transformer注意力头
papers.what_it_is: 论文将注意力头重要性评分用于表格数据上的多头Transformer解释与优化，并在40个表格数据集上验证。结果显示，按低重要性头逐步删除通常对性能影响最小，而先删除高重要性头会显著降低分类性能。
key_points: 在40个不同表格数据集上评估注意力头重要性与删头鲁棒性，72.5%的实验中删除低分头最不伤性能
重要注意力头分布在不同层中，没有稳定的层级规律
与视觉和语言任务不同，表格数据中注意力头重要性强烈依赖数据集结构、特征空间与schema
papers.why_notable: 该研究补足了表格Transformer可解释性与冗余分析的空白，可用于识别无效注意力头、提升模型效率，并为表格深度学习模型压缩提供实证依据。
papers.abstract: Computationally demanding and opaque deep learning models can be better understood and optimized by analyzing how they transform data. While deep transformers have been widely studied in computer vision and natural language processing, their application in tabular data remains relatively underexplored. This paper presents one of the first applications of an importance-scoring metric to interpret multi-head transformer models in learning from tabular data. Experiments conducted on 40 diverse tabular datasets demonstrate robustness to head drops based on the proposed head importance score. In 72.5\% of experimental examples, the model remains most resilient to performance drops when heads with the lowest importance scores are gradually removed. In contrast, removing the most important attention head first results in the greatest reduction in classification performance. A closer look at individual head importance scores across six attention layers reveals that important heads are scattered across layers, with no consistent layer-specific trends. In contrast to the image and language domains, the importance of individual attention heads varies considerably across tabular datasets with different schemas and feature spaces. The proposed importance score can improve efficiency and redundancy within transformer architectures. We make the source code for measuring the importance of individual attention heads publicly available.

papers.title: A Point-of-Prescription Safety-Check System for Adverse Drug Reactions in Rural Bangladeshi Hospitals: A Feasibility Study
papers.brief: 论文提出一个轻量级智能手机处方安全检查系统，用于在孟加拉乡村公立医院识别患者既往严重药物不良反应与新处方成分的冲突。系统以可行性研究定位，重点评估工作流适配、可用性、身份匹配可靠性与历史病例回溯检测能力。
papers.tldr: 面向孟加拉乡村医院的处方ADR安全检查。
papers.what_it_is: 论文提出一个轻量级智能手机处方安全检查系统，用于在孟加拉乡村公立医院识别患者既往严重药物不良反应与新处方成分的冲突。系统以可行性研究定位，重点评估工作流适配、可用性、身份匹配可靠性与历史病例回溯检测能力。
key_points: 注册时用电话号码等软标识记录患者，并维护严重药物反应史，弥补缺乏电子病历的问题。
医生开方后拍摄处方图像，将品牌药名映射到活性成分，再与患者不良反应记录进行检索匹配。
系统不做风险预测，默认静默，仅在高风险匹配时报警，以降低临床警报疲劳。
papers.why_notable: 该研究针对低资源、高就诊量医疗场景中的可预防用药伤害，提出成本低、工作流侵入小的数字化安全机制，具有较强的公共卫生和人机交互实践价值。
papers.abstract: Adverse drug reactions (ADRs) are a major, largely preventable source of patient harm. In high-income settings, electronic health records store a patient's allergy history and warn prescribers when a contraindicated drug is ordered; in rural Bangladeshi public hospitals no such record exists for outgoing patients, a single physician may see on the order of one patient per minute, and a patient's history of severe reactions does not survive between visits. This paper proposes and outlines the evaluation of a lightweight, smartphone-based safety-check system for this setting. At registration a soft identifier (a phone number) is recorded; after the physician writes a prescription, its image is captured, the brand names are resolved to active ingredients using national drug references, and the ingredients are matched against the patient's recorded severe reaction history. The system is retrieval-based rather than predictive, and is silent by default, raising a flag only for high-risk matches a design grounded in the alert-fatigue literature. We frame the work as a feasibility study: we describe the proposed framework and an evaluation plan measuring workflow fit under high volume, usability, identity-resolution reliability, and retrospective detection of known reaction cases. We explicitly do not claim a clinical-outcome effect, which the low base rate of severe events places beyond a single-site feasibility study.

papers.title: HALO: A Heterogeneity-Aware Language-Aligned IMU Foundation Model for Open-Set Human Activity Recognition
papers.brief: HALO 是一个面向惯性传感器人类活动识别的领域基础模型，旨在跨受试者、设备、采样率、通道配置和传感器位置泛化。它通过异构感知自监督预训练与语言对齐训练，实现无需每个数据集单独分类器的开放集活动识别。
papers.tldr: 面向开放集HAR的IMU基础模型
papers.what_it_is: HALO 是一个面向惯性传感器人类活动识别的领域基础模型，旨在跨受试者、设备、采样率、通道配置和传感器位置泛化。它通过异构感知自监督预训练与语言对齐训练，实现无需每个数据集单独分类器的开放集活动识别。
key_points: 第一阶段采用异构感知自监督学习，包括自适应池化分词、通道独立特征提取，以及将自然语言传感器描述注入通道嵌入的传感器条件化机制。
第二阶段用同义词感知的软对比学习对齐 IMU 表征与文本嵌入，可通过余弦相似度检索识别未见活动标签。
在10个公开HAR数据集训练、7个留出数据集评测中，HALO在8项聚合指标上超过5个SOTA基线；仅约3500万可训练参数，比MOMENT少10倍，零样本开放集准确率提升13.7个百分点。
papers.why_notable: 该工作把语言对齐和异构传感器建模结合到IMU活动识别中，缓解了HAR长期存在的设备与标签体系不统一问题，提升了跨数据集和开放集识别能力；同时模型规模较小，具备实际部署潜力。不过在严重分布偏移数据集上仍会崩溃，指出了该方向的关键瓶颈。
papers.abstract: Human Activity Recognition (HAR) using inertial measurement units (IMUs) enables a wide range of applications, yet the field still lacks a unified model that can generalize across diverse subjects, devices, and activities. Training such a model is difficult due to two key challenges: sensing heterogeneity -- differences in sampling rates, channel configurations, and sensor placements -- and poor generalization to unseen activities and label vocabularies. We introduce HALO (Heterogeneity-Aware Language-aligned Open-set model), a domain-specific IMU foundation model that addresses both challenges through a two-stage training framework. Stage 1 pretrains the IMU encoder with heterogeneity-aware self-supervised learning, including adaptive-pooling tokenization, channel-independent feature extraction, and contextualized sensor conditioning that injects natural-language sensor descriptions into each channel embedding. Stage 2 aligns this IMU encoder with text embeddings via synonym-aware soft contrastive learning, enabling open-set recognition via cosine-similarity retrieval without per-dataset classifiers. Trained on 10 public HAR datasets and evaluated on 7 held-out datasets, HALO outperforms five state-of-the-art baselines on all 8 aggregate metrics, and still leads on 3 of 4 settings under baseline-matched inputs. Despite using only ~35M trainable parameters -- 10x fewer than the latest foundation model MOMENT (341.2M) -- HALO improves zero-shot open-set accuracy, measured over all 87 training labels, by 13.7 percentage points. On two further datasets with severe distribution shift, every model including HALO collapses zero-shot. A video demonstration of HALO's performance in real world is available at https://youtu.be/rooVKragtFU

papers.title: Profit based evaluation of machine learning for nitrogen recommendations in winter wheat
papers.brief: 本文构建了一个基于利润而非预测精度的冬小麦施氮推荐评估框架，使用英国两个长期试验中的892条实测产量响应曲线，并扫描氮肥/粮食价格比来覆盖不同价格情景。研究发现机器学习模型作为直接预测器表现不佳，但作为标准建议后的校正步骤可显著减少利润损失。
papers.tldr: 机器学习宜修正小麦施氮建议而非替代标准。
papers.what_it_is: 本文构建了一个基于利润而非预测精度的冬小麦施氮推荐评估框架，使用英国两个长期试验中的892条实测产量响应曲线，并扫描氮肥/粮食价格比来覆盖不同价格情景。研究发现机器学习模型作为直接预测器表现不佳，但作为标准建议后的校正步骤可显著减少利润损失。
key_points: 直接用实测产量响应曲线上的利润损失评估施氮建议，而不是只看产量或最优施氮量预测误差。
在正常价格下，所有机器学习模型的利润表现都不如英国标准施氮建议，且噪声基准显示很难可靠恢复最优施氮率。
简单后处理校正可减少约25%的利润损失，在第二试验站点无需重训也可减少43%，标准建议加阻尼校正还能降低偏差和罕见大损失。
papers.why_notable: 论文提醒农业机器学习不能只追求预测精度，而应按真实经济目标评估；其结论对精准农业、肥料管理和低碳农业政策都有实际参考价值。
papers.abstract: Nitrogen rates for winter wheat are set before the season, under unknown prices and weather. The standard UK advice does not respond to prices, yet recent price swings moved the most profitable rate by tens of kilograms per hectare. Machine learning is often proposed as the fix. However, it is usually judged on prediction accuracy, and accurate prediction does not by itself make the recommended rate more profitable. Our insight is to score nitrogen advice directly by the profit it forgoes on measured yield response curves. We build a test bench on 892 such curves from two long running UK experiments, and sweep the nitrogen to grain price ratio to cover all price scenarios. On this bench, machine learning fails as a predictor. No model recovers the best rate within farm tolerance, and the benchmark noise shows none can. At normal prices, every model also loses to the standard advice on profit. The gain sits elsewhere. A simple correction step applied after the model cuts profit losses by a quarter, while better models and extra features give no gain. The same frozen correction cuts losses by 43% at the second site without any retraining. A hybrid of standard advice plus a damped correction removes bias and trims rare large losses. The same price sweep also prices emission cuts, at a cost comparable to current carbon prices. Machine learning therefore pays as a profit scored correction to standard advice, not as its replacement.

papers.title: Common Geodesics Do Not Guarantee Fisher Consistency of the Structured SVM: Minimal Counterexamples and a Tree-Metric Classification
papers.brief: 本文研究结构化SVM在常用坐标逐维argmax解码下的Fisher一致性，证明“公共测地线”这一已知必要条件并不充分。论文给出最小反例，并完整刻画了加权树度量中何时保持argmax一致性。
papers.tldr: 反例揭示结构化SVM解码一致性缺口
papers.what_it_is: 本文研究结构化SVM在常用坐标逐维argmax解码下的Fisher一致性，证明“公共测地线”这一已知必要条件并不充分。论文给出最小反例，并完整刻画了加权树度量中何时保持argmax一致性。
key_points: 构造四输出单位星形度量反例：存在精确最优评分向量，其所有最大化输出都严格非Bayes最优，且四输出是满足公共测地线条件下的最小规模反例。
完整分类以输出空间为顶点的正加权树度量：当且仅当树是一条路径时，结构化SVM的argmax一致性成立；分叉树的失败仅出现在边界分布上。
进一步证明在公共测地线条件下，五个输出是全支持分布反例的必要且充分规模，并给出K_{2,3}家族及三维Hamming立方体的全支持反例。
papers.why_notable: 该工作澄清了结构化SVM校准理论中的一个关键误区：即使嵌入保证存在某种校准链接，也不意味着预设的argmax解码器对所有替代风险最小解都一致。这对结构化预测损失设计和解码器选择具有重要理论警示意义。
papers.abstract: A known necessary condition for Fisher consistency of the structured support vector machine requires the task loss to be a metric for which every output triple has a common geodesic point. We show that this condition is not sufficient for the canonical coordinate-wise argmax decoder. A four-output unit star admits an exactly optimal score vector whose maximizers are all strictly non-Bayes, and four outputs are minimal among metrics satisfying the condition. We then completely classify positively weighted tree metrics whose vertex set is the output space: argmax consistency holds if and only if the tree is a path. The failure on branching trees is confined to boundary distributions; every tree retains the argmax property at every full-support distribution. Among metrics satisfying the common-geodesic condition, five outputs are necessary and sufficient for a full-support counterexample; $K_{2,3}$ is the smallest member of an infinite $K_{m,n}$ family. We additionally give a full-support counterexample for the three-dimensional Hamming cube. All optimality claims have exact primal-dual certificates. The counterexamples expose a concrete decoder gap: in this polyhedral setting, an embedding can guarantee the existence of a calibrated link without validating a prescribed argmax link on every surrogate-risk minimizer.

papers.title: When Interference Graphs Evolve: Doubly Robust Estimation of Dynamic Peer Effects
papers.brief: 论文提出受控对比框架，将潜在结果按个体处理、时间聚合的同伴暴露和处理后的网络演化摘要进行索引，用于刻画动态干扰图中的因果效应。进一步提出 DynaNet-DR 双重稳健估计器，在结果回归或倾向模型之一正确时保持一致性。
papers.tldr: 动态网络中稳健估计同伴效应
papers.what_it_is: 论文提出受控对比框架，将潜在结果按个体处理、时间聚合的同伴暴露和处理后的网络演化摘要进行索引，用于刻画动态干扰图中的因果效应。进一步提出 DynaNet-DR 双重稳健估计器，在结果回归或倾向模型之一正确时保持一致性。
key_points: 区分处理前网络历史、动态同伴暴露与处理后网络变化的不同因果角色，定义个体处理、同伴暴露、受控网络演化及联合受控对比
DynaNet-DR 结合时间分解倾向得分与归一化增广项，在一致性、序贯可交换性、正性、弱依赖等条件下具备双重稳健性
在真实时间图序列构造的半合成基准上，相比面向完整效应剖面的其他方法取得更好估计精度
papers.why_notable: 该工作面向会随时间变化的真实社交/交互网络，提供了比静态干扰假设更贴近现实的因果估计框架，对社交网络实验、平台干预和动态系统中的同伴效应分析具有实用价值。
papers.abstract: Peer effects are difficult to estimate when interaction graphs evolve because pre-assignment network history, dynamic peer exposure, and post-assignment network change have distinct causal roles. We introduce a controlled contrast framework that indexes potential outcomes by own treatment, temporally aggregated peer exposure, and a post-assignment evolution summary. Differences between the resulting means define own-treatment, peer-exposure, controlled network-evolution, and joint controlled contrasts rather than a mediation decomposition. We develop the Dynamic Network Doubly Robust estimator, DynaNet-DR, which combines a temporally factorized propensity with normalized augmentation.
